intro: Isi pax dan tarikh berlepas / balik — panjang trip, peak season dan semua surcharge dikira sendiri dan terus masuk dalam harga per pax. Blackout: Hari Nyepi 18–20 Mac 2026 (Bali tutup 24 jam) dan Hari Raya Aidilfitri 20–23 Mac 2026 — tour tidak tersedia; 2027: 5–10 Mac dan 9–12 Mac. Kalkulator tetap mengira tarikh itu, jadi semak sendiri. Honeymoon: harga flat per pasangan (2 pax) dan tidak menerima kanak-kanak. Malam villa dalam pakej Honeymoon kena surcaj peak season lebih tinggi daripada malam hotel — bila tarikh jatuh dalam peak window, tukar pilihan Accommodation hari villa kepada versi tambah surcaj peak season villa.

paxNotes.text: 13 pax ke atas: katalog beri tier harga sehingga 15 pax, tetapi rate card transport hanya sehingga Hiace 12 pax. Perlu dua kenderaan atau van 14-seater / bas 30-seater — sahkan kadar dengan operator sebelum quote.

validity: Prices are based on the PT Bali v3 catalogue dated 2 February 2026 and are valid for travel until 31 December 2026; departures from 1 January to 30 June 2027 carry the 2027 travel date surcharge. This quotation is valid for 24 hours. A deposit of RM250 per pax is due on confirmation and full payment 45 days before departure. The final itinerary and hotels are confirmed 14 days before the trip, subject to availability. Blackout dates: Hari Nyepi 18–20 March 2026 (Bali closes for 24 hours) and Hari Raya Aidilfitri 20–23 March 2026 — tours are not available.
